title: Enforce the latest registry state in SkillTool
objective: Make execution authorization immediate and authoritative, independent of stale model-visible catalog history.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid skill catalog design in the dirty shared worktree.
Registry state is authoritative; prompt messages are an append-only model projection and never the authorization boundary.

source_evidence.note: Bounded metadata catalog and on-demand full skill content.
Live discovery and four-state skill visibility controls.
Append-only messages preserve the prior cached prefix.

include: Resolve by stable ID or unambiguous invocation name against the latest Manager snapshot.
Distinguish model invocation from explicit user invocation.
Reject off, revoked, shadowed, stale-revision, and managed-denied calls.

Require explicit skills.InvocationOrigin and perform resolution, policy/revision validation, final body preparation, and envelope construction inside Manager.ResolveLatest's linearizable consume callback.
Append versioned full/short/superseding envelopes using only a ledger bound to the current context epoch.
Attach a validated SkillExecutionReceipt to ToolResultBlock metadata; task_19, not SkillTool, commits the loaded ledger after visible-history append.
Use semantic i18n keys with translations for every supported language for user-visible rejection and execution messages.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Add the smallest registry/policy integration to SkillTool.
Validate immediately before reading/rendering content to close TOCTOU windows.
Add stale-call, concurrent disable, manual-only, duplicate digest, and updated body tests.
acceptance_criteria: A disable racing with invocation cannot execute after authoritative validation.
Same digest avoids duplicate full body only when the loaded ledger belongs to the visible context epoch.
Execution emits but does not prematurely commit an epoch-bound receipt containing exact content and rendered payload digests.
Every new user-visible result or rejection resolves through a semantic i18n key in every supported language.
risks: tools/skill.go is a hot dirty file; do not absorb command or compaction changes.
dispatch_prompt: Wire SkillTool to the latest revisioned Manager and versioned invocation envelopes. Add focused enforcement/race tests; touch no other production files.
notes_for_assignee: Respect owned_files. Escalate contract gaps to the integration owner rather than editing another task's production files.
